control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage

facts.title: near hit - pressure exposure at P-7113

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-7113 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-7113 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 September 2006 a near hit was recorded on P-7113 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
